## Available benchmarks

### [Study 01: Separated-locus fine-mapping](01_finemapping/separated-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete development benchmark |
| Study type | Fine-mapping and credible-set evaluation |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC; ST-BED BayesR; ST-CSR SBayesC; ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Separated causal loci |
| Replicates or chains | 10 replicates |
| Primary outputs | Marker recovery, causal ranks, credible sets |
| Validation | 40/40 fits; simulation oracles and strict alignment passed |
| Capsule | [v1.1 reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/01_finemapping/separated-development-v1.1/README.md) |

### [Study 02: Single-trait prediction](02_prediction/prediction-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete one-replicate development benchmark |
| Study type | Held-out single-trait prediction |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC; ST-BED BayesR; ST-CSR SBayesC; ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Replicates or chains | One replicate per architecture |
| Primary outputs | Prediction correlation, NMSE, calibration, paired differences |
| Validation | 8/8 fits; training-only scaling, LD and summary statistics |
| Capsule | [Prediction reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/02_prediction/st-bayesc-bayesr-one-replicate-development-v1/README.md) |

### [Study 03: Single-trait parameter estimation](03_parameter_estimation/parameter-estimation-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete one-replicate development benchmark |
| Study type | Posterior parameter estimation |
| Methods | ST-BED BayesC; ST-BED BayesR; ST-CSR SBayesC; ST-CSR SBayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Replicates or chains | One replicate per architecture |
| Primary outputs | Effect, genetic and residual variance; heritability; posterior intervals |
| Validation | 8/8 fits; simulation oracles and posterior contracts passed |
| Capsule | [Parameter-estimation reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/03_parameter_estimation/st-parameter-estimation-one-replicate-development-v1/README.md) |

### [Study 04: Multichain convergence](04_convergence/convergence-development-pilot.qmd)

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Status | Complete one-replicate multichain development benchmark |
| Study type | Operational multichain convergence diagnostics |
| Methods | Matched ST-BED/CSR BayesC and BayesR |
| Architectures | Sparse homogeneous; sparse variance mixture |
| Replicates or chains | Four chains per method; 16 total |
| Primary outputs | R-hat, bulk/tail ESS, relative MCSE, burn-in stability, recommendations |
| Validation | 16/16 chains; retained identities and complete checkpoint grid |
| Capsule | [Convergence reproducibility capsule](../results/reference/04_convergence/st-multichain-convergence-development-v1/README.md) |

## Planned benchmarks

- Fine-mapping with realistic LD.
- High-LD causal architecture.
- Five-replicate single-trait prediction benchmark.
- Five-replicate single-trait parameter-estimation benchmark.
- Five-replicate validation of convergence-informed MCMC settings.
- Multi-trait prediction after computational optimization.
- Annotation-informed models.
- Block-eigen methods.
